desc: The Dedicated Marksman Rifle (DMR) is Seekins' do-it-all hammer. Designed for the rigorous and rough lifestyle of competition and duty use, this rifle Just. Won’t. Quit. This lower receiver offers ambidextrous controls maximizing efficient manipulation of the weapon from either side, while the proprietary upper receiver and handguard offer a rigid, stable platform for repeatable accuracy under any condition. NOW AVAILABLE in 6 semi-custom colors, make the DMR your “never quit” rifle!
